summary: Japan International Cooperation Agency filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an SEC-registered offering of USD-denominated guaranteed bonds, with the full faith and credit of Japan backing principal and interest. The filing sets forth terms for a sustainability bond issuance, including fixed semi-annual interest, maturity date, and a make-whole redemption upon tax-law changes. Net proceeds will finance Eligible Projects under the issuer's Social/Sustainability Bond Framework. The bonds will be listed on SGX-ST, cleared through DTC/Euroclear/Clearstream, and sold by underwriters Daiwa, Barclays, Goldman Sachs, and HSBC. This is a traditional debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
